QuestInfo.name: View from Above
QuestInfo.0: Since the younger ones are doing their best, so should you!
QuestInfo.1:
Go to the overlook at the summit and hone what you have learned during training.
You can reach Xuanshan Summit through the #eright-most path of the Xuanshan School#k.
QuestInfo.2: You ran into Yun Wu at the summit. The way he's been acting lately makes him almost unrecognizable from who he used to be. What changed him so much?
